elements: Top-bar link 'My orders and results' and phone-menu entry
Tabs Current / Results and reports / Previous
?tab= in the URL; rows from the existing order-centre endpoints
Result row: name, kind, date, 'Result ready'
GET /labs/bookings/mine and /radiology/bookings/mine: booking with reports[] or signed_report_pdf_url
no file field in the radiology booking payload
no endpoint shares a lab/radiology result; /consultations/share-report shares medical reports only
'New' badge on a result and the count badge on the top-bar button
no viewed/seen field on bookings; unread count would need a request in every page's render
Notification when a result is ready
backend report.ready (route /reports/:id) and /health/results/:id exist; the latter opens the result page whose back link is the Results tab
notes: Report-ready lab bookings stay in Previous too (the booking is finished): they are not removed from the past list.

needsReview.note: [backend] No endpoint shares a lab or radiology result with a doctor (only POST /medical-reports/:id/share for medical reports); button left out.

[backend] Bookings carry no viewed/seen flag, so 'new' and the count cannot be told truthfully; needs a field (e.g. results_unseen_count on /labs/bookings/mine) or a cheap count endpoint for the server-rendered header.
[backend] The radiology booking payload has no report file reference (only labs have reports[].has_file), so no PDF button for radiology.

[backend] report.ready sends route /reports/:id (a medical report) and radiology writes a provider bell only; a patient notification with route /health/results/:id or /diagnostics/results-history is needed for lab/radiology results (the web maps both to the new area).
